findings.description: score should be typed as a non-negative integer; the current `number` type allows fractional or negative scores that don't make sense for this leaderboard.
ranked.push spreads `entry` before setting `rank`, so if Entry ever gains a `rank` field of its own it would silently be overwritten.
formatRank's case for 2 doesn't handle negative ranks, which would produce a nonsensical ordinal string.
